_readme: Sources for the NASA HLS 30 m greenness cross-check of MODIS bare months (proposal #34; sources part #47). Each source note quotes the primary page and was checked by claude-pro2; verified: true only after that. Nothing reads this file yet: the pipeline PR for #34 cites these entries. The facts block repeats the checked values for the pipeline; each names the source that states it.

facts.fill_note: The HLS VI User Guide (Table 3) gives -19,999; the Earthdata catalogue pages give -9999. Reject both raw codes before scaling (scaled, -9999 would be -0.9999).
facts.premasked_note: The VI products already set cloud, cloud shadow and adjacent-to-cloud/shadow pixels to the fill value (VI User Guide §1.2). Water, snow and high aerosol are not masked there.

sources.title: NASA Earthdata, HLS Operational Land Imager Vegetation Indices Daily Global 30 m V2.0 (HLSL30_VI v2.0), doi:10.5067/HLS/HLSL30_VI.002
sources.note: Checked. The LP DAAC product page (lpdaac.usgs.gov/products/hlsl30_viv002) now redirects here. Short name 'HLSL30_VI', version '2.0'; temporal extent '2013-04-11 to Present'; '30 Meters x 30 Meters'. Variables table, NDVI row: 'Normalized Difference Vegetation Index', units 'N/A', 'int16', fill value '-9999', valid range '-1 to 1', scale factor '0.0001'. No Fmask or quality layer is listed.

sources.title: NASA Earthdata, HLS Sentinel-2 Multi-spectral Instrument Vegetation Indices Daily Global 30 m V2.0 (HLSS30_VI v2.0), doi:10.5067/HLS/HLSS30_VI.002
sources.note: Checked. The LP DAAC product page (lpdaac.usgs.gov/products/hlss30_viv002) now redirects here. Short name 'HLSS30_VI', version '2.0'; temporal extent '2015-11-28 to Present'; '30 Meters x 30 Meters'. NDVI row: units 'N/A', 'int16', fill value '-9999', valid range '-1 to 1', scale factor '0.0001'. The variables table lists only the nine vegetation indices (no Fmask).

sources.title: LP DAAC, Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS) Vegetation Indices (VI) Product User Guide, Product Version 2.0
sources.note: Checked (the guide shows no date). Table 3, NDVI row: 'NDVI none int16 0.0001 -19,999 -1 to 1 30'. §1.2: 'it is assigned a fill value of -19,999 for the vegetation index (VI)'; Fmask 'is used to mask out pixels classified as cloud, cloud shadow, or adjacent to cloud or cloud shadow' ... 'and the VI fill value is assigned accordingly.' §4.1: the original L30/S30 QA file 'can be used if additional filtering of water or snow or high aerosol pixels is desired', so water is not masked in the VI product. The fill code here (-19,999) differs from the Earthdata catalogue (-9999).

sources.title: LP DAAC, Harmonized Landsat And Sentinel-2 (HLS) Product User Guide, Product Version 2.0 (last updated April 2026), Table 9
sources.note: Checked. Fmask bit meanings for the HLSL30/HLSS30 QA ('Fmask') layer. Table 9: 'Description of the bits in the one-byte Quality Assessment layer.' 'Bits are listed from the least significant bit (bit 0) to the most significant bit (bit 7).' Bit 1 'Cloud', bit 2 'Adjacent to cloud/shadow', bit 3 'Cloud shadow', bit 5 'Water' (each 1 'Yes' / 0 'No'). §4.2: 'The results from the Fmask classes (cloud, shadow, snow/ice, water, adjacency) are stored in bits 1-5 in the QA band.'
